periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: The primary axis of the eye patches is oriented approximately 80 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis, tilted slightly outward at the dorsal ends.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Vertically elongated ovals with a visual ratio of approximately 1.4:1 height-to-width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Visible downward tapering where the patch narrows toward the muzzle.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: The posterior edge of the transverse band displays a shallow U-shape curvature across the dorsal midline.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: The dark band appears as a thick, uniform transverse stripe covering approximately 30 percent of the visible torso profile.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide gap between the ear regions, roughly equivalent to 1.5 times the width of a single pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Convex and smoothly rounded apex curvature on both ears.
